name: @nodegx/canvas-look
description: The NodeGX canvas look as data — category colour schemes, wire colours, card metrics, the structure lane, fonts — for a home-made editor that wants to look like NodeGX. GENERATED from the editor's CanvasTheme and token CSS (scripts/canvas-look/generate.js); a gate fails when it drifts. Phase 112 (OWN-005). No dependency on the editor at run time.
author: The Low Code Foundation <contact@thelowcodefoundation.com>
